title: DMVPN and FlexVPN: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: A company has fifty offices. Building a tunnel between every pair would be a nightmare. D M V P N builds them as needed.

scenes.heading: The private driver guild
scenes.narration: Drivers register with a central office, called the hub. The hub is the register of where everyone is. Each spoke tells the hub its real address. Spokes then find each other and build direct tunnels. The I P sec profile goes on the tunnel interface.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three traps. They share the same purpose. Phase three lets spokes talk directly. Use an I P sec profile.

items.wrong: Phase 3 still goes via the hub

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.narration: So, to recap. N H R P lets spokes find each other. Phase three builds direct tunnels. Flex V P N is the I K E version two way. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva DMVPN lab.

points.t: NHRP lets spokes find each other
